entry.title: What Books do Historians Actually Read? | BOOM Goes the History Bonus

media:group.media:title: What Books do Historians Actually Read? | BOOM Goes the History Bonus
media:group.media:description:
Join the hosts of the "Boom Goes the History" Podcast for a special live recording featuring an all-star panel of bestselling authors, award-winning historians and American Battlefield Trust BookFest presenters. Together, they'll pull back the curtain on the world of history books, discussing the inspiration behind their latest works, the challenges of researching the past, surprising discoveries, favorite sources and the stories that didn't make it into print.
This is a special bonus episode of Boom Goes the History with Kris White, Garry Adelman, Chris Mackowski, Sarah Kay Bierle and special guest Mark Lender.

entry.title: Fort William Henry: An Overlooked Chapter of the French & Indian War | BOOM Goes the History Ep. 18

media:group.media:title: Fort William Henry: An Overlooked Chapter of the French & Indian War | BOOM Goes the History Ep. 18
media:group.media:description:
Before the Revolution, another struggle helped shape America—and we’re heading to Fort William Henry to explore it. Join Chris Mackowski, Sarah Kay Bierle and Dan Davis on Boom Goes the History for a lively look at a sometimes overlooked chapter of the French and Indian War. From the clash of empires to the people caught in the middle, we’ll explore the fort’s dramatic story and its place in a world conflict.

entry.title: Horatio Gates: Revolutionary War Hero to Humiliation | In 3 Minutes

media:group.media:title: Horatio Gates: Revolutionary War Hero to Humiliation | In 3 Minutes
media:group.media:description:
In 1777 Horatio Gates found himself as one of the great American heroes after defeating the British at Saratoga and securing an alliance with France. Just three years later, his disastrous performance at the Battle of Camden wiped away the memory of his successes and led to his historical obscurity. Learn more about Horatio Gates: https://www.battlefields.org/learn/biographies/horatio-gates
Dan Davis of the American Battlefield Trust details the complex career of the once famed Continental General.

entry.title: Wait . . . The attack on Burnside Bridge was a success??

media:group.media:title: Wait . . . The attack on Burnside Bridge was a success??
media:group.media:description:
The Union attack on Burnside Bridge during the Battle of Antietam has gained a reputation for being a massive failure, but it actually worked (and pretty easily at that).
Join Dennis Frye and Garry Adelman as they explore the Antietam Battlefield from this unique perspective.
